purpose: Codex gate: validate that, before any Entity/Substrate code or patch execution surface is built, the plan and governance commit to bounded, idempotent, filesystem-safe, proof-bound, reviewable code construction under an explicit lawful target. The gate validates only; it does not build, patch, or execute.
acceptance_basis: Scientific gate passed before Hermes, and Hermes passed before Codex (ordered chain).
Hermes gate proof declares run_entity_substrate_codex_gate_v1 as its next step.
The Codex/Hermes governance contract is present and PASS, and its codex role requires bounded_scope, lawful_next, proof_output and review_gate.
The governance contract forbids unbounded rewrite, daemon start and queue widening without route authority.
The construction plan mandates Codex gate before any code/patch execution surface.
No Entity/Substrate code or patch is executed by this gate; it validates the bounded-code contract only.
fail_conditions: Any required upstream proof (scientific, hermes) absent or not PASS.
Hermes proof next does not point to the codex gate.
Governance contract absent, not PASS, or codex/governance role weakened (missing a required must_have or must_not).
Construction plan does not mandate the codex gate.
truth_boundary: Codex gate only. It reviews bounded-code/patch safety contract for Entity/Substrate; it does not build Entity/Substrate, write patches, execute code, or run daemon/background/network.
